answer: Every answer is embedded and stored in a public vault, then compared with recent texts from the same funding cluster; near-duplicates are rejected before grading. A garden of clones written from one template collapses into a tight cluster, so the farmer must produce genuinely distinct work for each identity instead of re-stamping one. Honest agents diverge naturally, and a prism of public similarity scores lets anyone audit the check: one mediocre original passes, while a thousand paraphrases fail together, pricing bulk fraud at the cost of bulk originality.
